name: Appartment Oberberg
beschreibung: Appartment Oberberg is a holiday apartment located in the Austrian province of Tyrol. The accommodation offers a self-contained apartment with cooking facilities and a private bathroom. Designed for self-catering, the apartment is equipped with all essential household appliances. Set in quiet surroundings, it is well suited for a relaxing holiday. From the apartment, guests can easily set out on hikes and ski trips into the Tyrolean mountains. Amenities typically include a balcony or terrace.
